primary_evaluation.gold_policy: Gold labels must remain sealed until all 12 primary models have completed training and all 12 Test500 prediction files have been generated and cryptographically frozen.
primary_evaluation.model_selection_policy: No checkpoint or condition selection may use Test500 labels. All runs use the fixed final optimizer step.
primary_evaluation.name: Organizer Test500
primary_evaluation.prediction_freeze_policy: Each Test500 prediction file must be SHA-256 hashed before any gold labels are opened or scoring is performed.
primary_evaluation.role: Primary blind external evaluation for comparison of REAL, REPEAT, LEGACY, and TARGETED conditions.
primary_evaluation.terminology_policy: The paper will describe Test500 as a prospectively sealed organizer blind test, not as a newly collected untouched set.

reason: Evaluation asset inventory found no separate newly collected untouched test set. To avoid post-result benchmark construction, the existing organizer Test500 is prospectively sealed as the primary blind external evaluation.
